baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative أَذِّن and the doubled coming verb يَأْتُوكَ / يَأْتِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A public signal leaves the addressee, becomes accepted hearing, and reverses direction as bodies converge on the intended, magnified destination from open remote passes.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge made public by a call supplies the outward signal that initiates convergence.
Listening that accepts what is heard supplies the receptive half of the call-and-response mechanism.
Intentional approach to something magnified supplies the common destination.
Repeated coming and arrival convert the transmitted call into visible response.
The wide opening between mountains supplies distributed corridors of approach.
Depth and road-distance make the reach of the response measurable.

changed_reading.before: Announce the pilgrimage so that travelers receive notice.
changed_reading.after: The utterance reorganizes distance: a signal cast outward returns as an embodied, many-routed convergence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رِجَالًا beside عَلَى كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ, followed by the remote pass.
baseline_models.mechanism: Walkers and conditioned, lightened mounts are paired modes whose bodies register preparation and the cost of distance; remoteness becomes visible in gait and leanness.

activation_trace.role: Walking on legs supplies direct human exertion as one arrival mode.
Lightness after conditioning supplies the prepared animal body as the other arrival mode.
Exhaustive enclosure extends the paired bodily modes across every mount and every route.
Long depth supplies the distance that explains bodily preparation and depletion.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists people on foot and people riding lean camels.
changed_reading.after: The arriving bodies themselves are distance records: feet bear effort, while trained leanness bears readiness for the long route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence بِٱلْحَجِّ ... مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A single intended destination is served by an exhaustive network of traveled roads, junctions, and open mountain corridors rather than by one privileged approach.

activation_trace.role: The clear intended road supplies destination-oriented routing.
A traveled public road or road meeting supplies network connectivity.
Total enclosure prevents the network from being reduced to a favored corridor.
A wide pass between mountains supplies the network's physical aperture.
Deep distance extends the network beyond the local horizon.

changed_reading.before: Pilgrims use distant roads to reach the rite.
changed_reading.after: The rite generates a center-oriented but radically distributed route system in which no single approach exhausts access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call becomes an effective opening of access: it counters obstruction, places resident and outsider on equal footing, and carries a permission-like force that mobilizes the public.

activation_trace.role: Permission and authorization supply a form-distant juridical force within the proclamation.
Visible humanity as a collective supplies the public whose access is at stake.
Turning away and obstructing supply the blocked condition that the proclamation reverses.
Equality between two sides supplies the access rule governing the public call.
Staying in devoted attendance supplies the resident side of the equality.
The open-country outsider supplies the nonresident side invited across distance.
Explicit permission elsewhere in the surah activates the authorization branch of the focus call.

structural_cues: 22:25 immediately frames the House as equally available to the resident and the outsider while condemning obstruction.
22:39 later reuses the focus root in an explicit permission construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obstruction, equal access, outsider inclusion, and explicit permission; I infer that proclamation causes practical access rather than merely conveying information. A live alternative is that the permission echo remains separate from the causative announcement form.

changed_reading.before: The command publicizes an already available pilgrimage.
changed_reading.after: The command performs public access, authorizing distant outsiders to cross a space that others would monopolize or obstruct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes acoustic reception from responsive understanding, so the proclamation is tested not by audibility alone but by hearing that becomes movement and reflective obedience.

activation_trace.role: Listening with acceptance supplies the response threshold internal to the proclamation.
Public notification supplies the audible summons whose effect is being tested.
The bodily ear supplies the material receiver while the verse denies that possession alone guarantees perception.
Understanding and compliance turn physical hearing into consequential reception.
The command to listen and heed renews the public audience's responsibility near the surah's close.

structural_cues: 22:46 pairs ears that hear with hearts that reason after travel through the land.
22:73 again addresses the people and commands them to listen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily ears, compliant hearing, reasoning hearts, and a renewed listening command; I infer a hearing-to-motion causal chain in 22:27. The alternative is a simpler promise of arrival with no implied audit of reception.

changed_reading.before: A sufficiently loud announcement reaches a distant audience.
changed_reading.after: The call sorts mere hearers from responsive hearers: true reception is disclosed when listening becomes reasoned, embodied approach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The long pass is not empty transit space; movement through ruined settlements turns the route into an archive whose visible remains can produce reasoning before arrival.

activation_trace.role: The intended clear road anchors the changed reading in pilgrimage travel.
The open mountain corridor supplies the traversed field of observation.
Extended depth supplies enough duration and range for the route to disclose history.
A settlement gathered in one place supplies the social landscape encountered on the road.
Collapse into destruction turns that landscape into preserved warning.
Travel and forward movement supply the act by which the warning is encountered.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the intended cognitive yield of travel.

structural_cues: 22:45 displays a ruined settlement, a disabled well, and a raised palace.
22:46 immediately asks why people have not traveled so that hearts may reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ruins followed by travel and reasoning; I infer that the pilgrimage road can function as a moving lesson. The live alternative is that 22:46 commends travel generally without modifying the focus journey.

changed_reading.before: Deep passes are logistical corridors to be crossed.
changed_reading.after: Deep passes are evidentiary corridors: arrival is preceded by reading the moral and material remains distributed along the road.

context_deltas.mechanism: Convergence creates co-presence in which benefits become witnessable and allotted provision moves toward people marked by need.

activation_trace.role: Intentional arrival at the magnified destination supplies the gathering condition.
Repeated bodily arrival supplies the co-presence required for witnessing and exchange.
Presence with observation turns arrival into witnessed participation.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the positive yield made visible by gathering.
An allotted gift supplies material that can circulate rather than remain privately held.
Feeding another supplies the transfer that converts provision into social benefit.
Material need supplies the unequal condition toward which provision is directed.

structural_cues: 22:28 directly continues the focus purpose clause with witnessing benefits, provision, eating, and feeding the poor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence arrival, witnessing, provision, and feeding; I infer that convergence enables redistribution. A live alternative is that the stated benefits are broader and not reducible to this social transfer.

changed_reading.after: Travel creates a temporary public in which benefits become observable and provision crosses from possessors to people in need.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated coming, rousing, life-death-life, and final return place the local procession inside a larger temporal pattern: a summons draws dispersed bodies toward an appointed convergence.

activation_trace.role: The doubled coming verb supplies the focus movement that can echo larger arrivals.
Exhaustive scope makes the local convergence available as a model of universal gathering.
The coming Hour extends arrival from geography into appointed time.
Rousing what is still supplies the activation of bodies for a final movement.
Two further arrivals, of the Hour or punishment, reinforce coming as a surah-scale temporal event.
Living embodied existence on both sides of death supplies the restored travelers.
Loss of life supplies the interruption that the second enlivening reverses.
Return to what was prior supplies the terminal direction of all affairs.

structural_cues: The surah opens with the Hour and resurrection, repeats the Hour's coming, and later sequences life, death, and life.
22:76 closes the late sequence by returning all affairs to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated coming, resurrection, restored life, and return; I infer that pilgrimage convergence rehearses that universal pattern in embodied miniature. The alternative is thematic recurrence without a processional analogy.

changed_reading.before: People come from remote geography to one historical gathering.
changed_reading.after: Their coming is a local rehearsal of a larger summons: bodies are activated across distance and time for an appointed return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exhaustive public call coordinates distinct communities and practiced rites around one divine orientation without pretending that their differences have already disappeared.

activation_trace.role: Humanity as a visible collective supplies the broad addressee.
Exhaustive inclusion supplies the total reach of mounts and routes.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood preserves unresolved differentiation among named groups.
A community or kind supplies plurality as an organized social fact.
A rite with its place and work supplies each community's concrete practice.
Divine oneness supplies the common orientation without erasing communal plurality.
Persistence on a practiced path supplies continuity and difference rather than a momentary label.

structural_cues: 22:17 names multiple religious groupings and defers separation to divine judgment.
22:34 and 22:67 repeat that every community has a rite while 22:34 states one God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies named difference, community-specific rites, and one divine orientation; I infer that the focus totality is coordinative rather than homogenizing. The alternative is that only the focus pilgrimage community is in view.

changed_reading.before: Every route supplies members of one undifferentiated crowd.
changed_reading.after: The universal call gathers across real communal and ritual difference, producing shared orientation without claiming premature sameness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prepared light body and wide pass become a design for demanding but traversable discipline: effort is real, yet the inherited route is opened rather than constricted.

activation_trace.role: Lightness after conditioning supplies effort embodied as readiness rather than collapse.
The wide opening between mountains supplies traversability under difficult terrain.
The intended clear road supplies disciplined direction.
Expenditure of capacity under hardship supplies the journey's genuine demand.
Narrowness and constraint supply what the religious route explicitly removes.
A road made recognizable by repeated use supplies the inherited Abrahamic path.

structural_cues: The final ayah joins strenuous exertion, the denial of constriction in religion, and Abraham's inherited way.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hardship, no constriction, and a repeatedly traveled inherited path; I infer that the focus's conditioned body and open pass materialize the same balance. The alternative is that leanness records distance without commenting on religious design.

changed_reading.before: A hard journey requires physical conditioning.
changed_reading.after: The hard journey images a disciplined way that spends capacity while remaining deliberately open, marked, and passable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from human travel into hydrology, but it remains anchored in focus branches for an incoming flood, watercourses, an open mountain pass, and depth, while the surah repeatedly stages delivered water reviving land. Render it only as a process analogy for convergence, not as the lexical meaning of the pilgrims.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combination of the two يَأْتِي forms, رِجَالًا, فَجّ, and عَمِيق.

activation_trace.role: A flood arriving from rain outside the land supplies distributed inflow from remote origins.
Watercourses supply branching channels through which the inflow can travel.
The wide mountain opening supplies a catchment corridor.
Depth and distant road supply the remote basin geometry.
Delivering something downward supplies the release of water into the landscape.
Conveying water by pouring or irrigation supplies the material flow.
Earth and plant movement into life supplies the collective effect of arriving flow.
Fresh green growth supplies the visible result of a second water-descent sequence.

changed_reading.before: Separate travelers cross mountain roads toward a center.
changed_reading.after: The proclamation makes the inhabited world act like a catchment: remote human streams enter open passes and gather toward a common basin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because mounts are normally treated as transport objects, yet it remains anchored in ضَامِر and the feminine-plural يَأْتِينَ, then gains context from moving creatures and sacrificial bodies designated as ritual signs. Qualify this as grammatical and ritual animation, not a claim that animals bear independent legal or moral agency.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The lean mount followed by the feminine-plural arrival verb يَأْتِينَ.

activation_trace.role: A body lightened through preparation supplies the nonhuman traveler named in the focus.
Coming and arrival supply the action grammatically resumed in the feminine plural after the mount.
Persistent striving in movement supplies one mapped image of animate creaturely participation.
Ground movement supplies the second mapped image of creatures acting within the surah's wider prostrating field.
The dedicated animal body supplies the mount's later ritual analogue.
A ritual marker supplies sign-bearing status to the animal body rather than reducing it to carriage or meat.

changed_reading.before: People come, using lean animals as vehicles.
changed_reading.after: The syntax lets prepared mounts come as fellow moving bodies, and the wider ritual sequence lets those bodies bear signs as well as burdens.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant cross-root activation: the context word حَرَج plainly concerns constriction, but its supplied branch inventory also contains a lean, long she-camel that unexpectedly mirrors ضَامِر. The link is valid as a packet-backed echo between the focus body and the final no-constriction claim; render it as wordplay-like resonance, never as a replacement gloss for حَرَج.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ضَامِر and the wide-open فَجّ in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Prepared leanness supplies the focus body unexpectedly echoed by the context inventory.
A wide open pass supplies the spatial opposite of constriction.
Effort under hardship keeps the echo tied to demanding preparation rather than ease alone.
Narrowness and constraint supply the ordinary mechanism explicitly negated in the context.
The lean, long she-camel supplies the surprising branch image that cross-lights the focus mount.
A frequently traveled, recognizable road keeps the echo within an inherited journey mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The lean mount shows the cost and preparation of difficult travel.
changed_reading.after: The lean mount can also image a paradox of the closing claim: strenuous discipline may narrow the body while the inherited religious road itself remains unconstricted and open.

strongest_changes: The proclamation changes from information transfer into equalized public access that counters obstruction.
Hearing changes from audibility into responsive reasoning disclosed by embodied approach.
The remote road changes from empty transit into both an evidentiary landscape and a small-scale rehearsal of universal return.
Arrival changes from attendance into witnessed benefit, redistribution, and disciplined effort without constriction.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly reactivated exact focus mechanics at long range: permission and ears reworked the call, travel and ruins reworked the deep pass, life-return sequences reworked coming, and the final effort/no-constriction cluster reworked the prepared lean body. The strangest packet-backed gains were the catchment-flow analogy, syntactic animation of mounts, and the ح ر ج branch that itself names a lean camel.
remaining_uncertainties: The authorization reading may be a contextual overlay on أَذِّن rather than part of its immediate causative force.
The resurrection and hydraulic models may be structural analogies rather than intended semantic extensions.
The feminine-plural arrival supports animation of the mounts, but not independent moral agency.
The lean-camel branch under ح ر ج is worth preserving only as a qualified cross-echo.
